Creates and stores 419 Oblivion ShadowLightShader passes and assigns their constant maps. Pool[6..9] are the mode-5 rigid opaque, rigid alpha-tested, skinned opaque, and skinned alpha-tested caster passes initialized by the native stage/pass table.

Verified (Oblivion): ShadowLightShader__LoadStagesAndPasses acquires and stores NiD3DPass pool objects into g_ShadowLightPassBySelector[0..0x1A2], AddRefs each stored pass, then installs the shared vertex shader in each pass at +0x58 before building the pass families. The four texture-effect template slots line up exactly with selector indices 0x18C..0x18F.
